prompt_text: Donor CRM that integrates with QuickBooks Online
aio_text:
AI Overview
Top Donor CRMs with QuickBooks Online integration include Bloomerang, DonorPerfect, Kindful, DonorDock, and Charityproud, which enable automatic syncing of donations to reduce manual entry.
Best Donor CRMs with QuickBooks Online Integration:
- Bloomerang: seamless 2-way syncing.
- DonorPerfect: detailed integration.
- DonorDock: cited.
